headline: Deutsche Bank Unit DWS Under Investigation Over Pension Entity
summary: German prosecutors and journalists uncovered scrutiny of a foundation managed by Deutsche Bank's asset arm DWS, which oversees €12 billion in company pensions outside BaFin anti-money laundering supervision.
why: DWS manages hundreds of billions in European client assets. Renewed regulatory or legal investigations threaten reputation and heighten compliance compliance costs for Deutsche Bank.

impacts.name: DWS Group
impacts.why: Reports of AML investigation risks on a €12 billion pension foundation create legal overhang.
